diagnostic_build: Copied the seven production .hpp/.cpp files into an isolated directory; changed only the fallback if to false; built with the existing CANN bisheng Ascend910B2 -O2 flags and matching shared-library SONAME. Selected the diagnostic library using LD_LIBRARY_PATH; each worker records its actual mapped library SHA256.

interpretation.bound: abs(error) <= 1e-5 + 1e-3*abs(reference); every output and final-state element
interpretation.control_flags: Only production control_flags_at_exit identifies actual fallback heads in the one-sequence H8 sweep. Parallel-only dispatch is disabled regardless of its retained flag values.
interpretation.max_abs: May be dominated by unavoidable FP16 output rounding; inspect ideal rounding floor and the worst-tolerance witness too.

heatmap_coverage.method: FP64 conservative bound: max_j<i |dot(k_i,k_j)| * beta_i * exp(g_i); nonpositive gates imply actual decay <= exp(g_i). Input hashes match the saved error heatmap.

validation.regression_command: bash scripts/gdn_mega_docker.sh python -m pytest tests/test_gdn_mega.py tests/test_gdn_mega_validation.py tests/test_gdn_mega_errors.py tests/test_gdn_mega_benchmark.py -q

diagnostic_launch: Inside the prepared container: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/mounted_home/autokernel_gdn/pto-kernels/benchmark_data/gdn_mega/correlation_risk/parallel_only:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH python benchmarking/audit_gdn_mega.py --suite correlation --output benchmark_data/gdn_mega/correlation_parallel.json
